method.checkout: isolated shared clone of actual Git history, checked out from staged index
method.inputs: 165 MANIFEST outputs restored and verified from exact gzip blobs; archived D5 scope ledger restored for QCORE retry
method.comparison: Move recorded outputs aside, actually generate, compare SHA256 and byte size, restore recorded bytes on mismatch; no --keep-going
method.retry_scope: Only initially failed/mismatching/blocked producers affected by concrete recipe fixes, plus the newly registered probe; prior successes were not repeated

limits: This is actual MANIFEST replay, not all repository producers or all small outputs.
CI enforces indexed storage policy; it does not run this replay.
status checks current main-file bytes and producer fingerprints, not proof of actual successful generation.
Declared sidecars are checked against pre-run existing bytes; missing sidecars are required to be generated, but their historical hashes are not recorded in MANIFEST.
status and default rebuild selection do not fully inspect sidecars.
Dependency inference is based on named paths and learned missing inputs, not a complete dependency proof.
Scratch .rebuilt/.recorded files can be replaced by later retries; the saved per-round receipts preserve this run history.
